description: Fever with rash and bleeding gums can indicate a severe infection with bleeding tendency — needs urgent care.

symptom_name_hi: मच्छर वाले इलाके की यात्रा के बाद बुखार
description: New fever after travel to an area with high mosquito activity, worth mentioning to a doctor.

symptom_name: Fever with Low Platelet Signs (Bruising, Bleeding Gums)

description: Fever with easy bruising or bleeding gums can indicate a drop in platelet count, seen in dengue.

symptom_name_hi: दवा से न उतरने वाला बुखार
description: Fever that continues despite standard fever-reducing medication, which needs medical review.
A bite wound from an animal, which needs prompt cleaning and medical evaluation for infection or rabies risk.

symptom_name_hi: बुखार के साथ त्वचा पर घाव
description: Skin sores appearing together with fever, which may indicate a spreading infection.

description: An infant feeding less than usual or refusing feeds.
Crying that is unusually prolonged, intense, or inconsolable in an infant.
A child not reaching expected physical, speech, or social milestones on time.

symptom_name: High Fever in Infant Under 3 Months
symptom_name_hi: 3 महीने से कम उम्र के शिशु में तेज़ बुखार

An infant who is unusually inactive, hard to wake, or unresponsive — needs prompt evaluation.

symptom_name_hi: शिशु को सांस लेने में तकलीफ
description: Any visible breathing difficulty in an infant is an emergency.
A baby consistently refusing to feed, which can be a sign of illness.

symptom_name_hi: बच्चे में बुखार के साथ दौरे

description: A skin rash appearing alongside fever in a child, seen in several childhood illnesses.

symptom_name: Dehydration Signs in Child (Dry Mouth, Few Wet Diapers)
symptom_name_hi: बच्चे में पानी की कमी के लक्षण

description: An infant gaining weight more slowly than expected for their age.
An infant who is unusually fussy or difficult to console.

symptom_name_hi: शिशु के होंठों का नीला पड़ना
